caption: The video depicts a woman in a cream button-up shirt seated at a wooden tea table, with a red tray holding three small white cups before her, a clay teapot on a warmer to her left, and two tea tins to her right, against shelves of reddish-brown teapots. She holds a small red clay teapot aloft in her right hand, tilted above the tray, and lowers it until it is hidden behind the tray rim. Vertical Chinese characters appear on the right edge as the teapot descends. Her hand then rests near the tray edge while her gaze stays directed downward at the cups through a largely still interval. Afterward her hand lifts off the tray into an open-palm gesture, rising and spreading as she appears to speak, continuing through the final frame. The framing and background stay fixed throughout.
relations: The teapot held in the right hand descends until occluded by the red tray rim.
As the teapot lowers, vertical Chinese characters emerge along the right edge of the frame.
The hand rests near the tray edge before rising into an open-palm gesture.
The camera framing and background shelves remain static throughout the sequence.
